resolution: Rebuilt the Studio model painter on direct RGBA pixel painting, replacing the box-atlas renderer (boxes->StaticSurface->texture) that produced every seam/leak/vanish bug. Phase A (framework): added an RGBA8 variant to gpu/paintable.zig (was R8-only) — per-paintable format, coloured brush ops with a scissor clip rect, two brush pipelines (one shader, two target formats), bpp-aware upload/readback, and a resolver registered with gpu.zig so a Scene3D mesh textureKey resolves to the paintable's view (paintable owns+caches its own 3D bind group). Phase B (cart): Studio paints in paint mode by raycasting to a face + interpolated UV (pickFaceUV) and stamping a coloured disc straight into the RGBA Paintable the mesh samples, clamped to the hit face's UV island; base coat = one clear. Proven on a real cube via cart/studio_paint_probe.tsx + tools/rjit shot (red base + adjacent crisp blue/green, no seam, clip respected). Commits 2 (framework + cart). NEEDS live AK paint test by user; Phase C (delete dead box-atlas PaintCells code) held until confirmed.
